quark_sign_branch: positive masses and m_d>m_u selected for the eta isospin application
inputs_role: All CKM data enter. The u mass is excluded from the inverse. eta alternative discards both d and u table entries. Only the pure-QCD BMW m_s/mud result is used, not their individually split up/down masses. The eta extraction needs its dispersive and chiral normalization and electromagnetic subtraction. R and S matching budgets separately transfer both low-QCD ratios to MZ; no statistically independent high-scale point.
